calls.statement:
SELECT 
  MIN(calendar_date) AS earliest_date,
  MAX(calendar_date) AS latest_date
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_week,
  MIN(calendar_date) AS week_start,
  MAX(calendar_date) AS week_end
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-09-20' AND calendar_date <= '2026-10-04'
GROUP BY fiscal_year, fiscal_week
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_week DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  sku,
  product_name
FROM dim_product
WHERE product_name LIKE '%Oulu Kaakkuri%'
AND is_current = true

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22

SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS units_returned,
  SUM(f.quantity) - SUM(COALESCE(r.quantity_returned, 0)) AS net_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22

SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  DATE(d.fiscal_week_start_date) as week_start,
  DATE(d.fiscal_week_end_date) as week_end,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE p.sku = 101624
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND d.fiscal_week = 22
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
